decisions.reason: The current rule covers the same prohibition on using Meta Llama 3, or allowing others to use it, for the listed unlawful, harmful, sensitive-information, professional-practice, rights-violating, and malicious-code conduct. It preserves the sensitive-information and unauthorized-practice limitations. Source lines 47–61.

The current rule covers the prohibition on engaging in, promoting, inciting, facilitating, or assisting with planning or development of activities posing a risk of death or bodily harm, including the listed examples. Source lines 63–69.

The current rule covers the candidate’s listed intentional-deception categories, including the consent, authorization, or legal-right limitation for impersonation. It also includes the separate listed nondisclosure category at line 78. Source lines 71–78.

Line 78 is a prohibited-use example—failure to appropriately disclose known AI-system dangers to end users—not an affirmative disclosure duty as represented by this candidate. The current rule captures that nondisclosure prohibition, including the known-danger and end-user conditions. Source lines 71–78.
